scenarioContextReviews.reviewNotes: Read police/locksmith ownership inquiry in all twelve locales. Preserved registration receipt versus purchase receipt, photo of frame number, no lock-opening permit, and parking-manager referral; corrected consultation receiver roles in Nepali/Bengali and Tagalog request.

Read commuter bag trial across all twelve locales: umbrella in hand, stiff button versus zipper pull, top closure, shortened shoulder strap and separate paper protection. Clarified Khmer limited waterproofing without asserting full water resistance.

Read peach purchase in all twelve locales: 600 yen/two versus 350 yen/one, soft ready-to-eat peach, surface spot versus dent, paper wrap and supported base. Corrected Thai readiness, Tagalog fruit damage and Hindi spot reference.

Read move-out invoice appointment in all twelve locales: weekday daytime work, next Thursday 17:00, documents if available, individual assessment and screen-accepted contract. Removed ambiguous Chinese time strings and literacy implications in Hindi/Tagalog.

Read tax envelope inquiry in all twelve locales: notice distinct from payment slip, four amounts versus first installment, mailing status explicitly unknown, both sheets retained during referral. Corrected Tagalog later-today assumption and Indonesian installment terminology.

Read sesame allergy restaurant exchange in all twelve locales: sesame remains in sauce, separate utensils requested but no dedicated area/no promise, no order and no cooking, player leaves. Corrected Indonesian postponed-order task and Hindi permission/suitability task.

Read split-bill exchange in all twelve locales: grilled fish plus oolong plus shared edamame assigned to departing player, later onigiri assigned to companion, 1800 yen/card/three receipt items. Corrected payer attribution and Bengali grilled-fish wording.

Read cut-steak order in all twelve locales: well-done bite size versus minced size, onion beside not below meat, less rice with unchanged meat portion. Corrected Chinese/Tagalog restaurant hospitality formula while preserving order constraints.

Read rainy garden rendezvous in all twelve locales: existing pond meeting, South Rest Area by entrance via bridge path, benches but no indoor restaurant, one hour until close, friend notified and bags put down. Corrected Hindi change-of-location syntax.

Read penguin feeding plan in all twelve locales: broad afternoon sign versus 13:00 today, 12:30 now, bench then notice check, outdoor-pool rather than tank side, left roof/shade and clear passage. Corrected Bengali/Burmese time breadth and Tagalog feeding-event references.

Read all twelve locales: workplace receipt versus separate itemized medical statement, diagnosis field absent on this receipt, today-only amount excluding pharmacy, questions at reception, separate envelopes by purpose. No sentence/task edits needed; no certification of real hospital policy.

Read all twelve locales: no workplace microwave, chilled noodles rather than heating, chopsticks separately, sauce sachet stays closed until meal, refrigeration required, ten-minute trip with cooler bag, one pair and refrigerator on arrival. No sentence/task edits needed.

Read all twelve locales: missed-delivery notice names another counter across station, company plus player addressee, who may collect/documents explicitly referred to handling counter, business card sufficiency asked in advance by phone, tracking number plus map. No sentence/task edits needed.

Read all twelve locales: blank inspection sheet not proof of completion, previous operator confirmation, stopped display only/no cover or power contact, actual inspector records inspection, player records awaiting confirmation, cart to designated waiting point and no machine operation. No sentence/task edits needed.

Read all twelve locales: two bags weigh eight kg including blanket, label permits home washing, ten-kg capacity not sole criterion, upper fill line and room to turn require splitting, two machines. Corrected Tagalog direction of fit between laundry and machine.

Read all twelve locales: ramen ticket lacks egg, extra ticket must be bought before cooking, 100-yen upper-row/right button, ramen ticket retained, extra ticket handed over and egg halved/served together. No sentence/task edits needed.

Read all twelve locales: co-residing friend/separate finances, household status referred to resident-registration staff without automatic decision, own move-in consultation despite absent friend, move-out papers plus new-address contract, numbered queue. Corrected Hindi seeker/giver advice role.

Read all twelve locales: first public-bath visit/forgotten soap, no provided soap but small bar sold, towel present/no container, resealable bag after draining, do not obstruct washing area, carry with towel during movement. No sentence/task edits needed.

Read all twelve locales: duration per pain episode distinct from onset day, yesterday/five minutes/three times today/no pain now, frequency includes count or time interval, current-state margin and immediate notification on change. Corrected Khmer medical frequency term and Tagalog time interval.

Read all twelve locales: decorative branches carried by train, 20-cm vase versus 40-cm branches, cut ends protected from drying, 40-minute journey, two thick plus one thin branch separately wrapped, all cut to 40 cm and small bag for friend. No sentence/task edits needed.
